overview: Entities, relationships, cardinality (1:1, 1:N, M:N), participation, weak entities aur ER se minimum tables nikalna.
coreConcept: M:N relationship ke liye alag table; 1:N me many side me foreign key; weak entity owner ke key ke saath table banati hai.
hinglishExplanation: ER diagram ko tables me convert karte waqt: har entity ek table, M:N relationship ek naya table, 1:N ya 1:1 me FK merge ho sakta hai (total participation ho to). Weak entity ka key = owner key + partial key.
formalDefinition: M:N relationship ke liye alag table; 1:N me many side me foreign key; weak entity owner ke key ke saath table banati hai.
importantProperties: Entity -> table; multi-valued attribute -> alag table.
1:N -> many side me FK (alag table zaroori nahi).
1:1 total participation: tables merge ho sakte hain.
Weak entity: identifying relationship, double rectangle/diamond; key = owner key + partial key.
Total participation: har entity relationship me aayegi.
commonPitfalls: Total participation ka merge ignore karna.
standardTechniques: Har entity/relationship ko cardinality se classify karo.
